pvObligation.name: PV obligation in existing buildings
pvObligation.description: Assists in determining the roof area that must be covered with PV when significant roof renovations are carried out.
pvObligation.roofsAreLoadingSpinner: Please be patient, the roofs are currently been loaded ...
pvObligation.generateReportSpinner: The report is currently been generated ...

wizard.introduction: This application is intended to assist in calculating the area that must be covered with photovoltaics when “significant roof modifications” are carried out. The PDF report is for your personal records and serves as proof in the event of a random check. You can find more information on the PV obligation here:
wizard.introductionPart2: None of the information provided below is stored on servers. The PDF is created locally on your computer. Data is handled in accordance with the DSGVO.

component.introduction: Click on the desired building in the map to determine the gross roof area.
component.hintSearch: (Tip: Use the search to find and display the building more quickly.)
component.grossAreaDescription: The gross roof area includes the entire roof area of the building, including all sub-areas regardless of orientation, use, or shading. If this area exceeds 50 m², it is subject to the PV obligation if ‘significant roof modifications’ are carried out.
component.grossAreaText: The gross roof area of the selected building is:
component.grossAreaHint: (Note: The roof areas have been recorded automatically. There may be deviations from the actual area. Please take this into account in the next step or under ‘Personal notes’.)
component.tooSmallAreaText: There is no PV obligation (minimum size 50 m²).

component.missingStepGrossAreaError: Please first select your roof in the step "Gross roof area".
component.missingStepGrossAreaMessage: Afterwards, the initial net roof area will be displayed here, and you can, if necessary, draw areas that should additionally be excluded.
component.netRoofAreaText: The selected net roof area is:
component.additionalNetAreaText: You can add and comment on other relevant areas to be considered for the calculation of the net roof area.
component.obligatedAreaText: Based on the currently determined net roof area, you have to install {{ obligatedArea }}m² of PV (30% of the net roof area).

component.missingStepGrossAreaError: Please first select your roof in the step "Gross roof area".
component.missingStepGrossAreaMessage: Afterwards, you can, if necessary, draw areas here that you want to designate as restricted areas.

form.reportCreatedBy: Report prepared by (if different from the owner)

component.generalError: Error: Not all required fields are filled in. Please complete the missing information to generate the report.

restrictionList.formHeaderCreateDescription: Use one of the drawing tools below to mark a relevant area on your roof and add a note. After saving, you can record more areas or edit them in the list.
restrictionList.numberExplaination: The identifier ({{ id }}) corresponds to the area marked on the map with the same ID.

helpFormDraw.text: To add a new relevant area, draw it directly on your roof area in the map. You can choose from rectangle, circle, and polygon shapes. When drawing a polygon, place the desired corner points one after another and finish the input with a double click.

helpFormDrawModify.text: You can modify the drawings you created directly on the map using the mouse.

restrictionList.missingAreaText: Please draw the area to be excluded from the net roof area.
